_comment: These weights control how the agent's confidence score is computed before it decides whether to open a PR. Each weight applies to a 0-1 sub-signal; scores are combined as a weighted sum and compared to confidence_threshold. Adjust these to tune precision (fewer, safer PRs) vs recall (more PRs, more risk of a bad fix).

notes.stack_trace_present: 1.0 if the log contains a full traceback, 0.0 if truncated/ambiguous (e.g. dag6).
notes.line_number_matches_source: 1.0 if the traceback's file+line matches the current source exactly (guards against the dag3/dag4 style mismatches seen before).
notes.known_fix_pattern_match: 1.0 if the exception type matches a pattern the agent has a template fix for (KeyError, FileNotFoundError, AttributeError, ModuleNotFoundError).
notes.log_completeness: Small bonus for logs with full timestamps/task context, penalizes sparse logs.
notes.external_dependency_detected: Negative weight — if the traceback bottoms out in a third-party library/network call (e.g. requests.HTTPError from an external host), this pulls confidence below threshold on purpose, since no code change here can fix it (dag5).
